```abap
      clear p_dynp_field-properties.
    when others.
      MESSAGE ID SY-MSGID TYPE SY-MSGTY NUMBER SY-MSGNO
                 WITH SY-MSGV1 SY-MSGV2 SY-MSGV3 SY-MSGV4
              raising not_executed.
  endcase.

ENDFORM.                    " R_PROPERTIES_OUT

*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      Form  R_LEAD_ZEROS_OUT
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*       RPY_DYNPRO_READ:                                               *
*       Verarbeiten der internen Angaben zu "Führende Null"            *
*       Aufbau des externen Attributes dazu                            *
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
*      -->P_FIELD_INT    Dynprofeld intern                             *
*      <--P_DYNP_FIELD   Dynprofeld extern                             *
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM R_LEAD_ZEROS_OUT
             USING    VALUE(P_FIELD_INT) TYPE DYNPRO_FIELD
             CHANGING P_DYNP_FIELD       TYPE RPYTY_DYNP_FIELD.
  IF P_FIELD_INT-FILL = '0'.
    P_DYNP_FIELD-LEAD_ZEROS = 'X'.
  ELSE.
    P_DYNP_FIELD-LEAD_ZEROS = ' '.
  ENDIF.
ENDFORM.                    " R_LEAD_ZEROS_OUT

*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      Form  R_TC_ATTRIBUTES_OUT
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*       RPY_DYNPRO_READ:                                               *
*       Verarbeiten der internen Angaben zu TC-Feld-Attributen         *
*       Aufbau der externen Attribute dazu                             *
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
*      -->P_FIELD_INT    Dynprofeld intern                             *
*      <--P_DYNP_FIELD   Dynprofeld extern                             *
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM R_TC_ATTRIBUTES_OUT
             USING    VALUE(P_FIELD_INT) TYPE DYNPRO_FIELD
             CHANGING P_DYNP_FIELD       TYPE RPYTY_DYNP_FIELD.

  IF P_FIELD_INT-LTYP = 'T'.      "nur für Felder eines TC
    IF P_FIELD_INT-COLN = 0.          "Zeilenmarkiersp. oder Titel
      IF P_FIELD_INT-FMB2 O FMB2TIT.        "Titel
        P_DYNP_FIELD-TC_TITLE  = 'X'.
        P_DYNP_FIELD-TC_SELCOL = ' '.
      ELSE.                                 "Zeilenmarkierspalte
        P_DYNP_FIELD-TC_TITLE  = ' '.
```
